verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Reversible adiabatic compression of diatomic ideal gas verified. Knowns: n = 2.0 mol, gamma = 1.4 = 7/5, C_V = (5/2)R, T_0 = 300 K, V_f = V_0 / 32 = 2^-5 * V_0, R = 8.314 J/(mol*K). Adiabatic state relation: T_f = T_0 * (V_0 / V_f)^(gamma - 1) = 300 * (32)^(0.4) = 300 * (2^5)^(2/5) = 300 * 2^2 = 1200 K. Internal energy change: Delta U = n * C_V * (T_f - T_0) = 2.0 * (2.5 * 8.314) * (1200 - 300) = 5.0 * 8.314 * 900 = 4500 * 8.314 = 37413 J = 37.413 kJ. Work done on gas: W_on = Delta U = +37.413 kJ; Work done by gas: W_by = -37.413 kJ. First Law verification: Q = Delta U + W_by = 37.413 kJ - 37.413 kJ = 0 kJ, exactly satisfying adiabatic definition Q = 0. Dimensional homogeneity: [T] = K, [W] = kJ, [Delta U] = kJ. Limiting cases audited: V_f = V_0 yields T_f = 300 K, Delta U = 0, W = 0. All calculations verified.
